name: NPTEL Practice
tagline: NPTEL exam prep, without re-reading the whole course.
description: Built to study for my own NPTEL exams without digging back through entire transcripts. Pick a course and week, and practice its quiz in Practice (answers shown right away), Quiz (checked as you go), or Mock Test (scored only at the end) mode. Questions render as full Markdown, including tables and images, and weeks can be mixed together with shuffled question and answer order for a randomized practice set. Entirely static and frontend-only, with progress tracked locally per week.

name: Scribo
tagline: Smart shopping lists that know what you need.
description: Built for my mom, who tracked groceries on paper and kept losing her lists. A local-first Android app where you keep master lists of everything the household stocks, enter what you currently have, and Scribo generates a shopping list of exactly what's missing. Partial buying is supported: buy less than needed and the remainder stays on the list automatically. Unit conversion works across weight, volume, and count. Now used by my mom's friends too.

name: CureFlow
tagline: Run your clinic. Not your spreadsheets.
description: Live multi-tenant SaaS I built for veterinary clinics, a segment with far fewer affordable software options than human clinics. Each clinic runs on its own subdomain with fully isolated data. Includes role-based access (Admin, Doctor, Receptionist) with timed edit windows, consultation sessions, prescriptions, appointments, billing with printable receipts, and a Super Admin layer to manage all tenants. In daily use at my mom's clinic for 2+ months.

name: Dotfiles
description: Version-controlled configuration for my Fedora + Hyprland development environment, written in Lua and Bash, so I can reproduce my full setup on any machine.

name: Attendify
description: Attendance tracker for college club events. Import the CSV exported from the event registration site and get an interactive interface to mark and track who showed up. Built with Express and EJS.

name: GhostFollow
tagline: Find the ghosts in your following list
description: Privacy-first tool that shows who doesn't follow you back on Instagram. You upload your own Instagram data export and it is processed locally in your browser, with no login, no password, and no data sent to a server. Deployed on Vercel.
